title: Tiny, cute rocket ship
svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100">
  <!-- exhaust flames -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="82" rx="8" ry="12" fill="#ff8c00"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="78" rx="5" ry="8" fill="#ffcc00"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="74" rx="3" ry="5" fill="#fff5cc"/>
  <!-- side fins -->
  <path d="M38 58 L28 74 L38 70 Z" fill="#e04040"/>
  <path d="M62 58 L72 74 L62 70 Z" fill="#e04040"/>
  <!-- main body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="48" rx="14" ry="22" fill="#e8e8f0"/>
  <!-- body shading -->
  <path d="M50 26 a14 22 0 0 0 0 44 a14 22 0 0 0 0 -44" fill="#c8c8d8" opacity="0.5"/>
  <!-- nose cone -->
  <path d="M50 18 Q62 34 62 42 L38 42 Q38 34 50 18 Z" fill="#e04040"/>
  <!-- nose highlight -->
  <path d="M50 22 Q58 34 58 40 L42 40 Q42 34 50 22 Z" fill="#ff6b6b" opacity="0.6"/>
  <!-- window ring -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="46" r="7" fill="#7ec8e3"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="46" r="5" fill="#a8e0f5"/>
  <!-- window shine -->
  <circle cx="48" cy="44" r="2" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <!-- bottom band -->
  <rect x="39" y="64" width="22" height="5" rx="2" fill="#a0a0b8"/>
  <!-- engine nozzle -->
  <path d="M43 68 L43 74 L57 74 L57 68 Z" fill="#8888a0"/>
  <!-- little screw details -->
  <circle cx="45" cy="70" r="1" fill="#c0c0d0"/>
  <circle cx="55" cy="70" r="1" fill="#c0c0d0"/>
</svg>
